Found 23 items in registries @channel3:

Showing items 1-23 of 23:

- format (registry:lib) - Price, currency, discount, domain, availability, and image helpers for Channel3 product data. [@channel3] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- variants (registry:lib) - Classifies variant option values into display tiers from `exists` and `available`. [@channel3] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- use-in-viewport (registry:hook) - Fires a callback when an element enters the viewport via IntersectionObserver, with one-shot and repeating modes for lazy sections and infinite-scroll sentinels. [@channel3] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- use-variant-selection (registry:hook) - Manages variant selection and server-side re-resolution via an injected resolver, keeping the API key on your server. [@channel3] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- search (registry:lib) - UI-friendly search filter state, conversion to the SDK SearchFilters payload, option lists, color presets, and hex helpers. [@channel3] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- use-product-recommendations (registry:hook) - Lazily fetches similar products when the section scrolls into view, via an injected fetcher, so it never blocks the PDP. [@channel3] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- use-async-options (registry:hook) - Debounced typeahead loader for brand/category suggestions, delegating to an injected server-side fetcher. [@channel3] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- use-product-search (registry:hook) - Query + filter state, debounced search, and infinite-scroll pagination via TanStack Query and an injected search fetcher. [@channel3] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- price-range-gauge (registry:component) - Plots the current price against its historical range as low/typical/high zones with a tick at the current price. [@channel3] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- price-history-chart (registry:component) - Area chart of a product's price over time, built on the shadcn chart wrapper. [@channel3] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- product-card (registry:component) - Borderless, image-forward product tile with hover image-swap and color swatches, for grids and carousels. Includes a loading skeleton. [@channel3] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- offers-list (registry:component) - Compares merchant offers for a product, cheapest first, with affiliate-tracked buy links. [@channel3] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- image-gallery (registry:component) - Product image carousel with a synced thumbnail strip. [@channel3] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- variant-selector (registry:component) - Renders every variant dimension as pills or swatches with three tiers of emphasis (purchasable, out-of-stock, not-offered). [@channel3] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- product-attributes (registry:component) - Renders a product's extracted attributes (structured_attributes plus materials, gender, and age) as a two-column definition list. [@channel3] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- product-grid (registry:component) - Responsive grid of product cards with loading skeletons and an empty state. [@channel3] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- product-carousel (registry:component) - Horizontally scrollable row of product cards with nav controls (e.g. "More like this"). [@channel3] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- product-details (registry:block) - Compound product detail page: gallery, header (all brands), variant selection, offers, price history, description, attributes, and an optional 'you might also like' carousel. Pairs with useVariantSelection. [@channel3] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- product-recommendations (registry:component) - Lazy "you might also like" carousel for a PDP: defers the findSimilar fetch until it scrolls into view and hides itself when empty. [@channel3] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- search-bar (registry:component) - Controlled search input with submit-on-Enter, a clear button, and an optional image-search trigger. [@channel3] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- product-filters (registry:component) - Compound, configurable filter panel (stacked sidebar or horizontal popover bar): price, gender, age, condition, availability, hex color palette with opt-in percentages, brand and category typeahead, and category-scoped attribute filters. [@channel3] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- product-search (registry:block) - Batteries-included search experience: search bar, configurable filters, and an infinite-scroll results grid wired to useProductSearch. [@channel3] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- all (registry:block) - Installs the full Channel3 UI kit: every component, hook, and lib in the registry. [@channel3] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`
